steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Cease fire! Watch out for civilians!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: They're getting away, Cohen!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't bother with them, protect the others!

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Someone come here, there are injured people here.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Let's bring them inside.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Doctor! Are you ok?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I'm here! I'm fine!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: My leg! My leg is broken! My leg! ......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Calm down, your leg is still here, it's just dislocated. Grit your teeth.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Mama... Mamaaa...

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Has anyone seen Algar's mother?

steps.name: Wounded Townsfolk
steps.text: Help me......please......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: We're running out of bandages......

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Those... (profanity)!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Is there a fire over there?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Isn't the town center in that direction?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Looks like this isn't the only place that was attacked.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Why? Where did the lord's guards go?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Don't care about those guards or whatever anymore.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: There are sounds of fighting everywhere now, and it's only getting worse. We can't stay here, it's too wide open.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Let's move those wounded behind this building for now!

steps.name: Infected Townsfolk
steps.text: Monsters! The monsters have come again!

steps.name: Infected Woman
steps.text: Help!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: This is endless!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Alexsandr! Get on the roof and cover us!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: There's no time, doctor. We need to leave this place.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: But, where can we go?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's go to your clinic.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: These Infected......

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't worry too much about it, let's get everyone to go to your clinic first.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ......Alright.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Someone lend a hand! He can't walk anymore!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz, can you go and check if there's anyone else hiding in these houses? Let's get everyone here to the clinic.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Stay safe!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: ......This is really a disaster.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Forty plus people......Is everyone here?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Everyone we've rescued......is here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How many are we missing?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Quite a number, maybe they went to the other side of the town.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: But some old ones......they didn't make it......

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Don't beat yourself up, it's not your fault.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: These monsters, where are they from? Are they trained beasts?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I don't know......I've never seen anything like them before.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: When those thugs drew their weapons, these monsters began burrowing out of the ground.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Who cares where they came from. How can there be so many of them?!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How's the surrounding situation?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: A big mess.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: There's sounds of combat from the other side of the town. I don't know what happened there.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How much ammo do we have left?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Not much, I only have four magazines left. If Alexsandr runs out of ammo then we're in big trouble.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Ammo isn't the biggest problem right now. This house isn't going to last much longer.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Judging by those monsters' size, if we let even one or two escape, they will definitely smash through this wall and it'll be impossible to stop them then. We need a plan.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Doctor, how are the patients doing?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Many of them are wounded, I'm only able to do some simple treatment.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: We're lacking bandages and disinfectants.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Is there any way to leave the town for now?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Where would we go after leaving town? While bringing so many with us?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Without food and water, going onto the wasteland means certain death.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I don't think these monsters will give up on attacking us. If we get to the wastelands, we'll just be in a worse position without any cover or means of hiding ourselves. Besides, we've all witnessed their burrowing abilities......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: I know a place......It might be safe.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: There's a special building at the south side of town. It might be the safest place in town, barring the lord's residence.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Do elaborate.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: There was this medical organization called Rhodes Island which rented a piece of land at the edge of town.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Later they hired workers to dig a fair amount of soil and stone and built a very solid house there.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ......It could be the strongest building around here? It looks just like a fortress.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How do you know that this 'Rhodes Island' would be willing to help us?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: There's only one watchman at that building, and I know him. I've purchased some medical supplies from him before.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: There's a lot of soil, most likely they dug out a basement.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Sounds like a safe house used by mercenaries.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Doesn't sound reliable.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Unless we have a better option, I suggest we take a look.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Without food nor water, staying in this place is no different than waiting for death.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: That building is at the edge of town. We can head over from outside town to avoid being seen by others.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz, is your shield still usable?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Half of it. I can use it to bash someone......probably.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I need someone to go with me, to help protect the doctor.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'll go. Worse comes to worst I can always shield the doctor with my body.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't talk crap.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz and I will go with the doctor to check out that 'safe house.' Tina, you stay here with Alexsandr.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Doctor, no matter what happens next, please follow my orders.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz, protect the doctor well.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'll keep him safe.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I don't see any lights, is there no one there?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Keep your distance. This building's door has been smashed.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Even here......

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What are these thugs' goals? To rob and plunder like common bandits?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Help! Anyone! Help me!

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: I......I don't want to die......Damn it......

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: It's the watchman!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't move and stay here.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'll go have a look.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: ......If only I didn't take this job......

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: I don't want to die here......

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Who are you!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Don't move, your leg's broken.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: M......mercenaries......

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Don't kill me! I beg you! Don't kill me! I really don't know where the key is! I'm just a simple watchman!

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Please believe me! I really don't know!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Calm down! I'm here to help.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You......you're not together with those guys......

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Help me! Help me!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I! Said! Calm down!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz! Bring the doctor!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Mister Occphen, your leg......

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You......you're that Infected doctor!

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Oh, thank heavens!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Don't worry, let me look at your leg.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Man, this place has been turned upside down.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The inside looks a lot smaller than the outside.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Secret doors, hidden rooms and fortified walls. Aren't all safe houses like that?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What's this?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Radio equipment? It's completely destroyed though.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Such a large machine, looks very retro. Turns out this world also had communications equipment like this.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: They even have cars after all, it's not strange for them to have radio.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: There were other 'broken electronics' back at the run-down house we stayed at before, like the fridge, fans, a kettle......Though none of them actually used electricity.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Just like this wireless radio, and that car we got.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: All these machines have a device filled with black crystals. I suppose that is the energy source for these devices.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Ouch ouch ouch! Please be gentler, doctor!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Please bear with it!

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: ......Luckily it's not very serious, the bone isn't broken.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: You're the person in charge of this place?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: This is......Rhodes Island's branch office. I'm actually just a simple watchman.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Let me guess, those thugs came here and forced you to open the basement door, but you persisted in your duty and kept playing dumb, which resulted in you getting beaten up and left here to die?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: ......Something like that.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Wait, how did you know there's a basement?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You've been tricked. We're actually the thugs' backup, here to get you to confess everything.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: What? ?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Kötz!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Don't get angry, I'm just trying to liven up the atmosphere.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: You......What are you actually planning to do?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Don't worry, they're good people. They've been protecting the inhabitants of the infected zone all this while.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: The infected zone was attacked as well? ?

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: This......It's messed up.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: What about the lord's soldiers? Where are Lord Tulla's soldiers?

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: The lord's soldiers still haven't appeared. They might be in trouble as well.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Mister Watchman, we need your help.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: But, what can I do to help? I can't even stand up right now.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: The Infected townsfolk have also been attacked, with many of them being injured and the buildings of the infected zone suffering heavy damages.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We need you to open up the safe house and let them hide in here.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: That...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: In return, we will guarantee your safety. You can trust us.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: But, but I...

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Based on the contract I signed with Rhodes Island, the entire safe house is the property of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: ......I don't have the authority......

steps.name: Occphen
steps.text: Alright, let them come. Losing my job is better than losing my life.

steps.name: Miarow
steps.text: Thank you!
